title: Godot asset packs, templates and official demos
description: Where Godot 4 projects get ready-made scenes and assets: the new Godot Asset Store (successor to the Asset Library), official demo projects (MIT code; check per-demo asset credits), Kenney starter kits (MIT code, CC0 assets), GDQuest demos (MIT code, but some art is CC-BY-NC-SA) and import docs.

items.title: Godot Asset Store
items.summary: Official successor to the Asset Library: community addons and template projects with reviews, versions and changelogs; integrated in the editor from Godot 4.7. Still marked beta on the home page.
items.licence: Per asset (each listing names its licence)
cautions: Assets were not migrated from the old Asset Library; authors must re-upload.
Selling assets is on the roadmap; check whether a listing is free before planning on it.

items.title: Godot docs: About the Asset Store
items.summary: Official docs: Templates (standalone projects shown in the Project Manager) versus addons (dropped into an existing project).

items.title: Godot docs: Submitting to the Asset Store
items.summary: Submission rules: the asset must work in the Godot version it lists; account required.

items.title: Godot Asset Store: Kenney publisher page
items.summary: Kenney's starter kits (3D platformer, racing, FPS ...) as installable Asset Store templates.

items.title: Godot Asset Store: Starter Kit 3D Platformer
items.summary: Store listing of Kenney's 3D platformer template.

items.title: Godot Asset Store: Godot XR publisher page
items.summary: XR Tools and XR sample projects from the Godot XR team.

items.title: Godot Asset Library (legacy)
items.summary: The original Asset Library; being deprecated in favour of the Asset Store and expected to become read-only, but still the source for many Godot 3/4 addons.
cautions: Deprecated: prefer the Asset Store for new work; older entries may target Godot 3.

items.title: godotengine/godot-asset-library (REST API + frontend)
items.summary: PHP frontend and REST API behind the legacy Asset Library; MIT; in maintenance mode.

items.title: Asset Library API reference (API.md)
items.summary: Endpoints: GET /configure, GET /asset (type, category, support, filter, user, cost, godot_version, max_results 1-500, page/offset, sort, reverse), GET /asset/{id}, GET /asset/edit/{id}.
cautions: Omitting godot_version lists only 2.1 assets and omitting type lists only addons; always pass both.

items.title: godotengine/godot-demo-projects
items.summary: Official demos (2d, 3d, audio, gui, networking, xr ...) distributed under MIT; many are also on the Asset Store.
cautions: MIT covers the code; some demos bundle third-party textures, fonts or music with their own licences (the voxel demo uses Minetest textures under CC BY-SA 3.0 and CC0). Read each demo's README credits.

items.title: Godot demo: 2D platformer
items.summary: Pixel-art side-scroller: character controller, enemies, physics bullets, one level (GDScript, Compatibility renderer). Music 'Pompy' by Hubert Lamontagne is credited in the README.
cautions: Credit the music author if you reuse the track.

items.title: Godot demo: 2D isometric
items.summary: Traditional isometric view with depth sorting; the character slides along and is occluded by objects.

items.title: Godot demo: grid navigation with AStarGrid2D
items.summary: Grid-based pathfinding with AStarGrid2D plus steering; the building block for top-down maze shorts.

items.title: Godot demo: 2D role-playing game
items.summary: Grid movement with simple JRPG dialogue and battle system.

items.title: Godot demo: 3D platformer
items.summary: CharacterBody3D platformer mirroring the 2D demo's code (GDScript, Forward+); touch input via a third-party virtual joystick add-on.

items.title: Godot demo: 3D voxel
items.summary: Minimal Minecraft-like voxel demo: chunked terrain, place/break blocks, render-distance settings.
items.licence: MIT code; textures CC BY-SA 3.0 / CC0 (Minetest Game); font CC BY
cautions: Textures include CC BY-SA 3.0 items (share-alike, credit each author listed in the README).

items.title: godotengine/tps-demo (third-person shooter)
items.summary: High-quality third-person shooter demo with lighting showcase; master branch tracks the latest Godot 4.
items.licence: MIT code; assets and music CC-BY 3.0
cautions: Assets are CC-BY 3.0 (Juan Linietsky, Fernando Miguel Calabro; music by Christian Fernando Perucchi): credit them if you reuse.

items.title: Kenney starter kits (Godot)
items.summary: Kenney's Godot source-code starter kits: match-3, racing, 3D platformer, FPS, city builder and a basic scene.

items.title: KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-3D-Platformer
items.summary: Basic 3D platformer template for Godot 4.6; code MIT, sprites/models/sounds CC0.

items.title: KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-City-Builder
items.summary: 3D city builder template for Godot 4.6: build/remove, smooth camera, dynamic MeshLibrary, save/load (F1/F2/F3). Code MIT, assets CC0.

items.title: KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-Racing
items.summary: Racing template for Godot 4.6: arcade vehicle controls, smoke, GridMap tracks, CC0 models and sounds.

items.title: KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-FPS
items.summary: First-person shooter template for Godot 4.6: controller, weapon switching, enemies, CC0 sprites and models.

items.title: GDQuest demos (GitHub organisation)
items.summary: 55 open-source Godot repos: 3D character controllers, premade characters (Sophia, Gobot, GDbot, Beetle Bot), shader tutorials, a Factorio-style 2D builder and a procedural dungeon.
items.licence: Per repo (code usually MIT; art varies)
cautions: Art licences differ per repo; some 3D characters are CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial).

items.title: GDQuest: godot-4-3D-Characters
items.summary: Drop-in animated 3D characters for Godot 4: GDBot, Sophia, Gobot, Round Bat, Bee Bot, Beetle Bot.
cautions: Non-commercial and share-alike: do not use in monetised shorts or commercial games; credit GDQuest.

items.title: GDQuest: godot-4-3d-third-person-controller
items.summary: Plug-and-play third-person shooter controller inspired by Ratchet and Clank. Code (scripts, scenes, shaders) MIT; textures and models CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0.
cautions: Reuse the code freely under MIT but replace the art for commercial work.

items.title: Godot Shaders (godotshaders.com)
items.summary: Community shader library; each shader is CC0, MIT or GPL-3.0 (stated at the bottom of the post). Images and videos in posts are not covered by the code licence.
items.licence: Per shader: CC0, MIT or GPL-3.0
cautions: GPL-3.0 shaders impose GPL terms on derivative shader code; prefer CC0/MIT for packages.

items.title: Terrain3D (TokisanGames)
items.summary: High-performance editable terrain system for Godot 4 (C++ GDExtension), MIT.

items.title: Aseprite Wizard (Godot plugin)
items.summary: Imports Aseprite animations into SpriteFrames, AnimatedSprite2D/3D and AnimationPlayer tracks for Sprite2D/Sprite3D/TextureRect; Godot 4 (Godot 3 on a branch). MIT.

items.title: Godot docs: Importing images
items.summary: Compression modes (Lossless for 2D and pixel art; VRAM Compressed for 3D), Detect 3D behaviour, and where texture filter lives in Godot 4 (CanvasItem/material, not import).

items.title: Godot class reference: ResourceImporterTexture
items.summary: Every texture import option (compress/mode, mipmaps/generate, process/fix_alpha_border, detect_3d/compress_to ...) that appears in a .import file.

items.title: Godot docs: Available 3D formats
items.summary: glTF 2.0 (.gltf/.glb) is recommended; .blend imports by calling Blender to export glTF; FBX via ufbx; OBJ is limited.

items.title: Godot docs: 3D scene import configuration
items.summary: Import dock options (Root Type, Apply Root Scale, Ensure Tangents, animation FPS), Blender-specific options and the Advanced Import Settings dialog.
